text: Runs standalone on Steam Frame (OpenXR) and as a tiny 64×48-per-eye version on the laptop iGPU
description: Inference as plain shaders (GLSL compute/fragment), so it runs on the Frame's mobile GPU and on the AMD Vega iGPU. Possible engine: Godot 4 (OpenXR, Linux + Android/ARM). Streaming from a PC is the fallback.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Where available, matrix-unit MLP evaluation cuts the net pass by another 2x or more, freeing budget for higher resolution or a wider net on the Frame.

status.comment: iGPU: runs at 512 px/eye, net run 6.3 ms after fp16 + per-eye pipelines (c30bda7, ada699e). Frame: package ready — `NET=nice-net native/build-frame.sh` builds build/frame/sunk-city.tar.gz (aarch64, glibc 2.31) with the trained net packed (start.sh sets WEIGHTS=net; before, the Frame package would have run random weights). Human step: upload build/frame/sunk-city/ with the SteamOS Devkit Client (start command ./start.sh, Steam Linux Runtime 4.0 ARM64), run, and send ~/sunk-city.log (GPU ms per pass, `stats` lines, whether shaderFloat16 is present).
